meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它会读取当前仓库所有打开的 issue 和 PR,逐个分析,并把带证据链接(permalink)的报告写入 /tmp 临时文件夹;全程只读,不在 GitHub 上做任何评论或修改。
howto.when: 当你说出「triage」、「triage issues」、「triage PRs」等触发词时,它会对当前 GitHub 仓库做只读分析。

say.text: 请 triage 当前仓库的 issue 和 PR
say.note: 它会分析所有打开的项目并写报告
开始分析所有打开的 issue

howto.what_en: It reads all open issues and PRs in the current repository, analyzes each one, and writes evidence-backed reports to a temp folder under /tmp. It never comments, merges, closes, or edits anything on GitHub; it only reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', etc. It then performs a read-only analysis of the current GitHub repository.

say_en.text: Please triage the issues and PRs in this repo.
say_en.note: It analyzes all open items and writes reports.
Runs a read-only analysis of the whole repo.
